summary: Smith & Nephew PLC filed a Form 6-K for the period ending June 27, 2026, disclosing a share buyback program initiated in May 2026. The filing references the May 2026 Share Buyback Programme, which involves the company repurchasing its own shares as a capital return to shareholders. The report covers the first half of 2026 and includes details on treasury shares and a prior August 2025 buyback program. As a UK issuer, this is equivalent to a US issuer tender or open-market repurchase disclosure. The filing indicates ongoing buyback activity but does not specify total value, share count, or price. Watch for periodic updates on buyback completion and any program expansion.
